text: Reset a work password from the identity portal. We email a one-time link to the address on your employee profile. Other signed-in sessions stay open until they expire, unless you choose Sign out everywhere.
Find an employee by work email in the company directory. Search is keyed by email. Do not download the full employee list to look up one person.
Invoice webhooks can arrive more than once. Use the event id to ignore duplicates. Process invoice.paid only the first time you see that id.
Help-center semantic search runs in a single region. Extra database regions can replicate documents; they do not add another vector-search capacity unit.
